roles.title: Producer
roles.summary: Picks each topic and angle, convenes the team, and makes the final go / no-go: every gate must pass or nothing ships.

roles.title: Researcher
roles.summary: Finds the real data that answers the question, downloads it, and hands the team a fact sheet with the biggest moves highlighted.

roles.title: Writer
roles.summary: Outlines the video, writes the script act by act from the fact sheet, and revises it with the Editor's notes.

roles.title: Editor
roles.summary: The quality gate: pre-flights the outline, fact-checks every figure, enforces YouTube's rules (no advice, persona or hype) and blocks repeats.

roles.title: Designer
roles.summary: Plans the visuals from the finished script (animated charts, concrete footage, callouts) and designs a thumbnail that matches the title.

roles.title: Post-Production
roles.summary: Records the narration and cuts voice, charts, footage, captions and music into the final video.

roles.title: Publisher
roles.summary: Writes the title, description and chapters, uploads, and reviews how the channel is doing.

roles.title: Boss (you + Claude Code)
roles.summary: Sets priorities, owns secrets and approvals; dispatches the Claude Code roster to build and maintain the studio.
